description: Shoppers seek reliable customer service and brand trust, frequently abandoning platforms when support fails.
Buyers monitor shipping status and rely on dependable delivery timelines, reacting strongly to unexpected order cancellations or false delivery reports.
Consumers evaluate garment quality, fabric feel, and accurate visual descriptions to ensure delivered items meet expectations.
Customers navigate complex return policies and pickup processes when attempting to send back unsuitable or damaged items.
Cost-conscious shoppers compare prices across platforms, apply discounts, and avoid added fees to ensure competitive purchase value.
Buyers assess clothing dimensions and check stock availability to find the correct size before ordering.
Users navigate platform features, payment options, and wishlists to find and manage items efficiently.
Shoppers turn to peers for styling recommendations, brand suggestions, and guidance on combining online and offline pieces.
Users actively request and share exact product links to locate and purchase items seen in media posts.
